summary: Frontend-only verification of two new Podcast features (Resume Chip + Autoplay Next) plus podcast regression. All targeted tests passed. Resume Chip renders with correct percent (13% listened for 120s/900s track), respects all eligibility rules (fresh state, <=5s, >=95%, currentTrack==resumeTrack), and tapping it restores audio currentTime (~121s). Autoplay-Next correctly advances to next non-premium track (skipping premium), and stops (paused) when last non-premium finishes. Regression: category filter, search, premium paywall, daily-pick play, and progress bars all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: AudioPlayerContext.playTrack toggles play/pause when re-clicking the same track — works correctly, no StrictMode double-invoke observed.

handleEnded logic is closure-captured; because it's attached via JSX prop it re-renders each state change, so it correctly sees the latest currentTrack/podcasts — verified via 'ended' dispatch advancing tracks then stopping at last.
Resume eligibility computation uses durationMinutes*60 as denominator; percent display uses Math.round — 120/900 correctly rendered as 13%. Boundary conditions (>5 and <95%) correctly excluded.
test_credentials: Any valid email + 6+ char password logs in as Grace; auto-auth on fresh load.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage seeding for vitality_last_podcast_track_id and vitality_podcast_progress to simulate saved playback state.
